_atelier_note: W8.3 + trust-fence PreToolUse + GAP-6/rigor Stop hooks scaffold. Merge into `.claude/settings.json` to enable. Each command resolves the hooks dir in three tiers — $ATELIER_HOOKS_DIR, then $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/atelier/hooks (dev clone), then ${ATELIER_HOME:-$HOME/.atelier}/current/hooks (packaged install) — and prints one actionable line to stderr if none resolve, so a guard is never silently inert. The Stop array holds two gates: stop-gate.sh enforces W5 TWIN/FUZZ/SOAK markers AND — only once a project runs `atelier stop-gate enable` — the GAP-6 close-marker backstop; rigor-goal-stop-gate enforces a sealed /rigor Layer-1 drive and is a silent no-op until `atelier rigor stop-gate install --apply` creates it. Both are inert on a fresh repo, so wiring this is safe.

hooks.command: sh -c 'for d in "${ATELIER_HOOKS_DIR:-}" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/atelier/hooks" "${ATELIER_HOME:-$HOME/.atelier}/current/hooks"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/$1" ] && exec bash "$d/$1"; done; echo "atelier: $1 not found (set ATELIER_HOOKS_DIR); guard inert" >&2' _ block-prototype-read.sh
